integrations.name: llama.cpp
integrations.summary: Fast local GGUF inference with CPU and accelerator backends.
integrations.verification: Official command contract reviewed; Super ii's separate persistent llama.cpp path is integration-tested.
warnings: Model chat-template and architecture support still depend on the exact GGUF metadata.

integrations.name: Ollama
integrations.summary: Import a reviewed GGUF into a named local Ollama model.
integrations.verification: Official GGUF import and run commands reviewed; generated Modelfile is deterministic.
warnings: Ollama architecture support is narrower than the GGUF container format; an import can still be rejected.

integrations.name: MLX LM
integrations.summary: Apple-Silicon-native text generation from an MLX model directory.
integrations.verification: Official local-path generation and server command contracts reviewed.
warnings: MLX LM documents its server as development-oriented with only basic security checks; keep it on loopback.

integrations.name: Transformers
integrations.summary: Load a reviewed local Transformers repository from an exact directory.
integrations.verification: Official installation and local from_pretrained contract reviewed.

commands.label: Install in an active virtual environment

warnings: Custom model code is never enabled by generated instructions; review code separately before opting into trust_remote_code.

integrations.name: Diffusers
integrations.summary: Load a reviewed local diffusion pipeline without a hosted inference service.
integrations.verification: Official installation, local-path, and offline-cache contracts reviewed.

commands.label: Install in an active virtual environment

warnings: Generated examples load local reviewed files and do not enable custom pipeline code.
Diffusers has deprecated DDUF loading and documents removal in version 0.41.0; prefer a standard Diffusers directory for a durable workflow.

integrations.name: Transformers.js
integrations.summary: Run compatible ONNX weights in this browser with WASM or WebGPU.
integrations.verification: The checked-in browser bundle and local-file proxy pass the Super ii release build; a reviewed model is still required.
warnings: WebGPU support varies by browser; Super ii falls back to local WASM when available.

integrations.name: LM Studio
integrations.summary: Import the reviewed model into a local desktop application while keeping the original file.
integrations.verification: Official lms import CLI contract reviewed; no undocumented deep link is generated.

commands.label: Import and keep the reviewed file

warnings: Select and load the imported model in LM Studio before using its API server.

integrations.name: Jan
integrations.summary: Import reviewed GGUF files through Jan's local model settings.
integrations.verification: Official local GGUF import and OpenAI-compatible endpoint documentation reviewed; no undocumented deep link is generated.
warnings: Import is an explicit desktop action; Super ii does not claim or invoke an undocumented jan:// deep link.

integrations.name: Docker Model Runner
integrations.summary: Package reviewed local model files as a local OCI model artifact.
integrations.verification: Official package and run CLI contracts reviewed; generated commands do not push an artifact.
warnings: The generated package command is local-only and deliberately omits --push.

integrations.name: vLLM
integrations.summary: High-throughput OpenAI-compatible serving for supported accelerator hosts.
integrations.verification: Official vllm serve and OpenAI-compatible API contracts reviewed; Super ii does not provide the required GPU host.
warnings: Requires a separately provisioned compatible accelerator; it is not part of Super ii's zero-cost hosted capacity.

integrations.name: SGLang
integrations.summary: OpenAI-compatible serving for supported Linux accelerator hosts.
integrations.verification: Official launch_server and OpenAI-compatible API contracts reviewed; Super ii does not provide the required GPU host.
warnings: Requires a separately provisioned compatible accelerator; model-specific chat or reasoning parsers may also be required.

integrations.name: Super ii Runtime
integrations.summary: Authenticated operator-owned inference for reviewed compatible models when runtime capacity is ready.
integrations.verification: Control-plane and persistent llama.cpp request paths pass release checks; availability remains runtime- and model-dependent.
warnings: No free hosted GPU pool is promised. Sign-in, readiness, rate limits, and available operator capacity are required.

agents.name: Codex
agents.summary: Connect Codex to Super ii's read-only Streamable HTTP MCP for discovery and verified downloads. This does not replace Codex's own model.

agents.name: Pi
agents.summary: Generate a models.json provider entry for a loopback OpenAI-compatible server.

agents.name: Hermes Agent
agents.summary: Generate a config.yaml model entry for a loopback OpenAI-compatible server.

agents.name: OpenClaw
agents.summary: Generate an explicit local provider entry with zero-price metadata and a loopback endpoint.
